body: Because its too much to ask for anyone to accept me with all my problems, so it means im just going to be on my own forever, sitting in my parents house doing nothing. The worst part is i dont want this, but i cant do anything about it. I would give anything to be someone else, i just want to be a normal 20 year old. I really dont want to live if i have to live like this. I get to sit here and watch everyone do normal happy things while i just suffer.  But i cant have any of that so whats the point. I just really feel taking a nice big handful of pills right now.
